# Antimuscarinics (Respiratory)


*Antimuscarinics with predominantly cardiac effects are covered at [Antimuscarinics (Cardiac)](../autonomic/antimuscarinicsansmd.qmd), whilst [atropine](../cvs/atropine.qmd) is covered separately.*

These agents competitively antagonise ACh at M~3~ receptors in bronchial smooth muscle, preventing parasympathetic mediated bronchoconstriction.


```{r}
source("scripts/drugtables.R")

DrugTable("ipratropium", "tiotropium", caption = "Respiratory Antimuscarinics")
```
